value.rationale: A natural complete critical-sampling design has exact sharp frame bounds and mean-square defect for every even dimension, optimally weighted in the full positive simplex (not just classwise). The jitter fraction gives dimension-independent stability even beyond the conventional one-quarter sufficient perturbation range, plus a sharp quadratic collision blowup. The result provides an actionable no-compensation theorem and exact reconstruction-stability constants, not merely a finite numerical improvement.
